title: Magic Drum Set

Setting: cozy kids playroom, pastel walls, wooden floor, wooden toy shelves. The drums start playing themselves faster, confetti popping out with every hit
Setting: cozy kids playroom, pastel walls, wooden floor, wooden toy shelves. Both kids drum on everything in sight while stars and confetti fill the room
Setting: cozy kids playroom, pastel walls, wooden floor, wooden toy shelves. Hoji hits one final cymbal, winks at camera, and raises his stick to loop
